content_variants.text:
Ain Al-Arab (Kobani) | Civilians inj*ured in Turkish ground shel*ling on villages in Aleppo

Aleppo province: Two civilians were injured by Turkish shelling with mortar shells on Nawroz Square in south eastern of Ain Al-Arab (Kobani) City within SDF-held areas, where the injured people were taken to medical centres.

Meanwhile, three shells were fired on Mamid Village southern of Ain Al-Arab (Kobani).

Earlier today, Turkish forces and their proxies renewed their bombardment of SDF-held areas, weeks after cautious calm, where the bombardment concentrated on Kherbat Shaeir, Qabr Qarajnah and Sheikh Ali villages in Tel Tamer countryside northwest of Al-Hasakah. No causalities were reported.
